unresolved_prerequisites: Frontier 239 contains no register or stack payload. The normal return from 0x80051300 is therefore restricted to eight byte-proven JAL continuations but cannot honestly be reduced to one from that receipt alone.
Authorization must resume at 0x80050F8C and preserve the authenticated machine stack; it must not synthesize a return target from this static receipt.
The first hardware-dependent boot decision is after the goal call returns at 0x80030128; no disc-status result or post-call branch is authorized by this pre-call slice.
